# ICP / Audience

**We are starting with active crypto traders who make short price calls and care about keeping their positions private.**

## Who comes first

| Audience | What they need |
| --- | --- |
| **Active traders** | A fast Up/Down quote, clear cost and payout, and private positions. |
| **Canton builders** | A working application whose contract visibility and settlement rules they can inspect. |
| **Early testers** | An easy DevNet flow and a direct way to share feedback. |

## The job to be done

When I have a view on the next price close, I want to take a firm quote, keep my position between my seat and the venue, and verify how the outcome was decided.

## Reach and learn

- Invite testers through **Canton community demos**, **@owarine_app**, and direct trader walkthroughs.
- Watch where users get stuck between opening the demo and completing their first trade.
- Use feedback to improve quote clarity, onboarding, and the mobile experience.

The current prototype uses **demo credits and DevNet test funds**. Paying customers, pricing, and repeat-use demand are still being validated.
